text:
Using Codex to set up Claude Code because opening the terminal requires an extra click. I assume this is how the singularity starts.

(NB: I use both Code and Codex, in case people take this an indicator of preferences) https://t.co/NNadr2BBl0

A big thing about Fable (and Sol, though a little bit less) is that you need to be really careful about treating it the way you would a less capable model. Skills that worked well for Opus often make Fable outputs worse, and too many lists of negative instructions can do the same

我感觉，拿着提示词 ，让 大模型 + claude code 去挖 fastjson 1.2.28 的 0day 变种，可以成为大三实习生敲开大厂的门的敲门砖 ，垫脚石了。

从前搞这种安全研究的事儿，通常都博士起，

有的安全博士没啥成就，也就开源了 Redos 扫描器，

现在有了大模型， 初中生， 大三，都可以做这些事情。
Enough transactions for everyone on Earth to transact on TRON nearly twice. 👀
